messagingSessionId.title: messagingSessionId
messagingSessionId.description: The ID of the current messaging session.

studentEmail.title: studentEmail
studentEmail.description: The student's email address, only if they gave it earlier in this conversation. Leave blank otherwise.

studentName.title: studentName
studentName.description: The student's first and last name, only if they gave it earlier in this conversation (for example when registering or asking for a follow-up). Leave blank otherwise; never guess.

summary.title: summary
summary.description: Under 250 characters: the student's issue, what RamBot already answered or checked, and what the student needs from the advisor. Write it without gendered pronouns: use the student's name or 'they', never he or she.
